title: Files, paths & serialization
outcome: Work on disposable files with explicit formats, encodings and ownership.

steps.title: 1. Work in a practice directory
steps.text: The tests create a temporary root and inject it as root. Implement the named callable using pathlib paths. Never point these learning scripts at production folders or credentials.
steps.code:
from pathlib import Path
# root is a temporary practice directory supplied by the checker.

steps.title: 2. Read and write explicitly
steps.text: Choose UTF-8 for text contracts. A with statement closes a file reliably. Keep append behavior distinct from replacement and exclusive creation.

steps.title: 3. Respect paths
steps.text: Do not follow symlinks or accept traversal when the contract prohibits it. Path comparison needs resolved paths, not a string prefix test. These are local exercises, not a race-proof production filesystem service.

steps.title: 4. Use real format parsers
steps.text: Use csv for quoted fields, json for structured objects, hashlib for content digests. Do not silently change source files while creating a report.

steps.title: 5. Test non-happy cases
steps.text: Test empty, missing, duplicate and invalid content using disposable fixtures. Environment-specific permission semantics require review on the target operating system.

tasks.title: Read UTF-8 text
contract: Define read_text(path). Return complete UTF-8 text unchanged. Missing files raise FileNotFoundError.
hints: Identify what must change and what must stay unchanged in this task: read utf-8 text.
Specify UTF-8 explicitly instead of relying on the operating system's default encoding.
Compare the implementation with case 03-missing. Trace the supplied inputs and the exact return/output type before changing the code.
